simple.meaning: גָּאָה (gâʼâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to mount up; hence, in general, to rise , (figuratively) be majestic.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 7 times in Exodus, Job, Ezekiel, beginning at Exodus 15:1. The surrounding contexts include family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּאָה (H1342) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּאָה (gâʼâh) / H1342 is traced through Exodus 15:1, Exodus 15:21, Job 8:11, Job 10:16 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1342. gaah גָּאָה verb rise up (Aramaic Pe`al ( ᵑ7 1Sam 2:5 ) & often Ethpe`el אֶתְגָּאֵי , be boastful, proud , compare also Late Hebrew) — Qal Perfect ׳ג Exod 15:1 , 21 , גָּאוּ Ezek 47:5 ; Imperfect יִגְאֶה Job 8:11 ; 10:16 ; Infinitive absolute גָּאֹה Exod 15:1 , 21 ; — 1 rise up , of waters Ezek 47:5 . 2 grow up , of plants Job 8:11 . 3 be lifted up, exalted , of head Job 10:16 , of ׳י in triumph Exod 15:1 , 21 . גאה (probably √ of following; Biblical Hebrew גָּאָה rise up ).
